action.command: export S3_ACCESS_KEY=$(grep -oE 'MINIO_ROOT_USER=\S+' /workspace/.env | cut -d= -f2); export S3_SECRET=$(grep -oE 'MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD=\S+' /workspace/.env | cut -d= -f2); docker exec workspace-minio-init-1 sh -c 'mc alias list 2>/dev/null | head -5; for a in $(mc alias list 2>/dev/null | grep -oE "^local" | head -1); do mc ls $a 2>/dev/null; done' 2>&1 | head; echo "---"; docker exec workspace-minio-init-1 which mc 2>&1
